nodes.label: Android Round Launcher Icon (mdpi, 48x48)
nodes.rationale: Round variant of the Android app launcher icon at medium density (48x48 px). It shows the default Expo/React Native template artwork: the Android robot head centered on a solid teal-green circular background, indicating the project has not replaced the stock generated icons with custom OPC branding. Served to launchers that request circular icons (Pixel-style).
